content:
FINDINGS:
[Visualized lower lungs are clear.]



[Heart is normal in size without pericardial effusion.]



[Liver is normal in size, contour, and attenuation without intrahepatic or extrahepatic biliary ductal dilatation.]



[Gallbladder normal without gallbladder wall thickening or pericholecystic fluid.  No calcified stones within the gallbladder.]



[Spleen is normal in size, contour, and attenuation.]



[Pancreas is normal in size, attenuation, and contour without pancreatic ductal dilatation.]



[No adrenal masses.]



[Kidneys are normal in size, contour, and attenuation without hydronephrosis, perinephric fluid collection, or perinephric stranding.  Urinary bladder is normal.] 



[No bowel obstruction, pneumoperitoneum, pneumatosis, or ascites.]  [Normal appendix.]  [No free or loculated fluid collections within the abdomen or pelvis.]



[Abdominal aorta and arborizing branches are normal in course and caliber.]



[No inguinal, pelvic sidewall, mesenteric, retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy.]



[Lumbar spine alignment is anatomic without spinal canal stenosis or foraminal narrowing.]

CONCLUSION:
[]



Thank you for the opportunity to provide your interpretation.
